race.comment: MARKET SNITZ (8) returned with a bang over 1100m at Northam and he looks a very progressive talent on the way through. This looks a logical jump in grade on what he's done and his last start figure stacks up. Can sit handy from the outset and will be tough to run down with no weight on his back. EXCELINDEED (9) led and scored over 1200m at Belmont last start in a good effort. Should be able to find the front from an inside barrier again here and can be in front for a long way. THAT IS JUSTICE (12) was impressive on debut and looks to have a high ceiling. Creates plenty of interest. DELZEE (6) can be flying home late in the race.
